{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies net_processing message handling to prevent assertion crashes during GETBLOCKTXN and handle block storage I/O failures gracefully.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.38,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents ungraceful assertion crashes and silent request drops in net_processing when block data cannot be read from disk. The problem is a genuine reliability defect in peer message servicing, though it only manifests during rare filesystem read failures."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test utilities and new test suites directly serve validation and P2P error handling rather than test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning specific area behavior belong to those areas rather than general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Validation label and alters block storage file opening in FlatFileSeq and exception handling during chain activation.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.62,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes an issue where filesystem failures cause exceptions to bypass FatalError in ActivateBestChain, leaving the node silently stuck rather than terminating cleanly. Proper crash safety and clean shutdown under underlying storage failures are critical for node operational reliability."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
